info.title: Momentum Skill Intake
info.description: Commits an approved skill into the skills repository. The approval decision is made upstream and arrives here already settled; this API owns the mechanics of the write only.

post.description: Checks that an upload is shaped like a skill and reports what it contains. Writes nothing. Call this when a user attaches a file, keep the response with the attachment, and show it to the approver later.

200.description: The package was read. Check isValid — an invalid skill is still a 200, because the question was answered.

400.description: The request itself was malformed — bad JSON, or content that is not base64.

post.description: Extracts an uploaded .md, .zip or .skill package, writes it under plugins/{segment}/skills/{solutionId}__{name}/, registers the segment in marketplace.json, and pushes one commit to the branch. Renaming a previously adopted skill moves its folder rather than leaving a duplicate.

400.description: The upload or its destination is not usable. The detail names what to fix.

403.description: The caller could not be authenticated to the git host, or has no write access to the repository.

409.description: The branch moved faster than the commit could be prepared. Retry.

post.description: Creates the skills repository if it is missing and seeds the marketplace manifest, README and .gitattributes if they are missing. Idempotent — safe to call on every deployment. A 200 with a null commitId means the repository was already fine. CommitApprovedSkill fails until this has run once, because it reads the manifest and will not invent one.

200.description: The repository is ready. Check wasInitialised and commitId to tell 'already fine' from 'seeded now'.

400.description: The configured target is not usable — a repository name that is a GUID, an unknown branch, an unsafe segment name.

403.description: The credential could not be authenticated, or cannot create a repository in this project or organization.

409.description: Someone else pushed the first commit while this one was being prepared. Retry.

ProvisionSkillsRequest.description: Every field is optional. An empty body provisions exactly what the function app's configuration describes.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Branch to seed. Defaults to the configured branch, normally main.

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: Plugin segments to scaffold. Convenience only — a segment is registered on first adoption anyway, so this just decides what is visible before any skill has been adopted. Ignored when the manifest already exists.

target.title: Target
target.description: Host and repository as the app resolved them, e.g. 'GitHub cyclotron/skills'. Echoed back because a wrong target is the failure that looks like a permissions problem.

auth.title: Auth mode
auth.description: Caller or Pat. The mode only — the token is never returned.

repositoryCreated.title: Repository created
repositoryCreated.description: True when this call created the repository.

wasInitialised.title: Was already initialised
wasInitialised.description: True when the manifest was already present, i.e. nothing that mattered changed.

commitId.title: Commit id
commitId.description: The seed commit, or null when there was nothing to seed.

uploadFileName.title: File name
uploadFileName.description: Original file name. Its extension selects how the upload is unpacked: .md, .zip or .skill.

isValid.title: Is valid
isValid.description: False when any issue has severity error. Warnings do not block a commit.

skillName.title: Skill name
skillName.description: Read from the name field of the package's SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.title: Description
description.description: Read from SKILL.md frontmatter. This is what an agent uses to decide whether the skill applies.

severity.description: Errors block a commit; warnings are for the approver to weigh.

code.description: Stable identifier, e.g. missing-frontmatter. Branch on this rather than on the message, which will be reworded.

skillName.title: Rename skill to
skillName.description: Optional. Rewrites the name in the committed SKILL.md frontmatter — use it when the contributor's name needs correcting at approval. Leave empty to keep what they wrote. Must be lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Unrelated to the folder name, which is always the solution id.

solutionId.title: Solution id
solutionId.description: GUID of the solution being adopted. Prefixes the skill's folder name as {solutionId}__{name}, and is the whole of the link between the repository and the catalogue.

segment.title: Segment
segment.description: Plugin folder the skill lands in, chosen by the reviewer.

uploadFileName.title: File name
uploadFileName.description: Original file name. Its extension selects how the upload is unpacked: .md, .zip or .skill.

uploadContentBase64.title: File content
uploadContentBase64.description: The package, base64 encoded. Encoding inflates the payload by roughly a third, and connector calls time out near 120 seconds — keep archives well under the 20 MB uncompressed ceiling.

approvedBy.title: Approved by
approvedBy.description: Who signed this off. Recorded in the commit message as corroboration; Azure DevOps records the actual author from the caller's own token.

pluginVersion.title: Plugin version
pluginVersion.description: Version recorded in marketplace.json for this segment. Defaults to 1.0.0 for a new segment; leave empty to keep an existing version unchanged.

destinationPath.title: Destination path
destinationPath.description: Repository folder the skill was written to.

isNewSegment.title: New segment
isNewSegment.description: True when this intake registered the segment in marketplace.json for the first time.

scopes.api://REPLACE-WITH-CLIENT-ID/user_impers: Commit skills as the signed-in user.
